Scarlet Intercept Flight.name: Scarlet Intercept Flight
Scarlet Intercept Flight.description: The user folds their wings into a fast dive across fifty meters and spreads them to catch one falling adult before landing at a visible clear spot this turn. The user needs height and most flight feathers attached; the passenger's weight prevents a sharp second turn, and a blocked landing forces an early drop to a lower ledge. Strain: heavy.
